about: Gaps and defects found by the viability experiment. needs: what a full fix takes (schema = new or relaxed fields, no new logic; schema+code = new engine logic; content = a pass over existing records; tooling = commands around the engine). scope: reusable = the mechanism occurs across many programmes; program-specific = one programme. status: what this experiment did about it.

G1.title: Prose restrictions were never enforced: a condition on who has a benefit, written as text, did not stop the engine reporting it as established
G1.status: engine guard built here (unchecked); 20 of 73 real candidates need their gates moved into it before promotion

G2.title: Facts about an account that conditions depend on are not modelled: primary or authorized user, new applicant, bonus history, country of the linked account
G2.status: open; such benefits stay UNRESOLVED, which is safe but permanent

G3.title: A programme's own status tiers: earned on several measures within a period, then valid for a stated term. `earns` is card-only, one measure, calendar year; metric conditions have no period and no term
G3.status: open; workaround with year-named metrics decides qualification but not how long the status lasts

G4.title: Changed terms could not be recorded next to the old ones: a successor rule was refused as a duplicate, so the only routes rewrote or erased past answers
G4.status: corrected here after the batch 2 measurement (non-overlapping dates are successors); in-place revision and retire_rule still rewrite or erase the past

G5.title: A recurring credit whose period the source does not state cannot be recorded as a credit (the cycle is required)

G6.title: Recurring grants (anniversary points, free-night awards) have no structure: no amount, no date

G7.title: Transfer terms beyond the ratio (minimum, increment, timing, bonus tiers) are text; the calculation does not apply them
G7.status: open; amounts are exact arithmetic with the terms printed beside them

G8.title: A member's choice among awards is not recorded; elections exist only for cards

G9.title: Earning formulas and grants of qualifying points (PQP equal to the fare; starting PQP by status) are text

G10.title: Earning rates with a cap or a minimum purchase cannot be recorded with their limits
G10.status: open; such rates were left as text rather than recorded without limits (batch 1: Peloton)

G11.title: Redemption values (cents per point, 'up to' values) have no structure, so nothing compares currencies

G12.title: The CSV tables author 7 record types; transfers, acquisitions, thresholds, unchecked conditions and earning rates need hand-written changesets

G13.title: Intake is one hand-written changeset per record with its sources repeated in full, and one promotion changeset per record
G13.status: sheet expander exists only inside the experiment

G14.title: The same fact entered twice in different shapes (a card-benefit row and a separate status rule) can disagree
G14.status: open; seen on Sapphire Reserve IHG Platinum and Priority Pass

G15.title: Card-year definitions differ by issuer; credits count the year from the opening date

G16.title: Bilt Cash wallet, per-grant expiry and the linked Legacy Election
G16.status: elections built in ENG-02/02B; wallet not built

G17.title: A card's own source list cannot name a source until some rule has brought that source into the store
G17.status: open; batch 2 dropped the field to proceed

G18.title: retire_rule removes a rule from answers about every date, including dates when it was true
G18.status: open; end a rule with valid_to instead
